summary: Full backend + frontend smoke test for Algo Trading Bot. All 10 backend pytest cases passed (100%). All 5 tabs render correctly in Expo web preview with live yfinance data, AI streaming works, paper trading flow (buy/sell/insufficient cash/over-sell) validated, watchlist CRUD validated.

minor.issue: TATAMOTORS.NS occasionally returns 'Data unavailable' from yfinance (Yahoo reports symbol delisted/404). Backend handles gracefully (returns price=0 / skips in signals). Suggest using TATAMOTORS.BO fallback or removing from list if persistent.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking but should be migrated.

action_items: Optional: Replace TATAMOTORS.NS with TATAMOTORS.BO or guard the popular list against persistent yfinance 404s.
Optional: Update pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence deprecation warning.
Consider adding more testID attributes on tab bar items, stock rows, BUY/SELL/Run buttons and watchlist + button for more robust future automation (currently we relied on visible text which works).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 587-line file mixing models, indicator math, market data, watchlist, paper trading and AI streaming. Consider splitting into routers/services modules as it grows.

compute_indicators uses pandas .rolling without min_periods; latest values can be NaN-coerced via fallback, which is fine but signal generation reads sma50.iloc[-2] without NaN guard for short histories (could KeyError on very short series). Mitigated because endpoint requests 6mo history.
Module-level _quote_cache is a plain dict (not thread-safe) — acceptable for single uvicorn worker but flag for scaling.
POSITIVE: Proper async wrapping of blocking yfinance calls with asyncio.to_thread + semaphore; MongoDB _id correctly excluded; HTTP 400 for business errors; env vars used via os.environ['..'].
seed_data_creation: Test fixture creates and cleans up TEST.NS in watchlist, and resets portfolio before/after paper trade tests so no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. yfinance is occasionally flaky for individual NSE symbols (notably TATAMOTORS.NS); tests are written tolerant (skip on 404) and core flows use RELIANCE.NS which is reliable. Paper trading uses single default_user with ₹10L starting cash — reset endpoint must be called before deterministic tests. AI /api/ai/analyze is a Server-Sent Events style text/event-stream; consume with stream=True.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. TATAMOTORS.NS warning in backend logs is a Yahoo Finance upstream data hiccup (symbol intermittently 404), not an app bug. Backend already returns a safe 'Data unavailable' shape so UI continues to render. Recommended mitigation: swap to .BO suffix or hide row when price==0.
